description: x402-perp-funding-arb: The same perpetual, priced for carry on two venues at once — Polymarket Perps and Hyperliquid — with both hourly funding rates annualised onto the same basis and the spread between them. Funding is what a leveraged position pays or earns every hour, so a venue that charges far less (or pays far more) is the difference between a carry trade that works and one that bleeds. Both venues publish this keylessly, which is why one call can do what no single-venue service can. Optionally pass symbol to check one asset.
name: x402-perp-funding-arb
